name: Entrancing Melisma
body:
Requirement: Perform 7 ranks

Base effect: All enemies within 30 feet take a –2 penalty to Will saves. The penalty becomes 1 point higher at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter (maximum –6 at 20th level). A successful Will saving throw reduces the penalty to –1.

Refrain

You focus the hypnotic power of your melody on a single creature within 30 feet, affecting its mind. A successful Will save negates the effect. This refrain is a mind-affecting effect.

Weak Refrain: the target is staggered for 1d4+1 rounds.

Intermediate Refrain: the target is dazed for 1d3 rounds.

Strong refrain: you control the target (as per dominate monster) for 1 round.
